status: Accepted as decision support with R905-C1 source-provenance and compatibility limits, and R905-C2 descriptor-path correction. The report does not establish the root cause of the recorded INVALID_ARGUMENT.

sections: 8-20: Recorded API result, installed package/SONAME versions, process mappings, and source pins; apply R905-C1.
24-33: Source-proved INVALID_ARGUMENT paths and count semantics; apply R905-C2 to the captured PERFORMANCE type.
37-39: Activation-context and pool-call-context comparison; keep the implementation/version boundary.
43-55: Compatibility, OA permission, and bounded diagnostic discussion; preserve all non-causation caveats.
keys: First pool-create returned INVALID_ARGUMENT after enumeration and activation success; query and numerical oracle did not complete.
Compute-runtime maps Metrics Library QueryCreate failure and zero report size to the same public error.
Runtime/loader version alignment and Metrics Discovery/Library package versions are identified, but exact Metrics Discovery/Library source revisions are not established.
The API pool-call hContext is forwarded but not read in the pinned OA method; the context difference alone is not the cause.
One small instrumented run can record init, report-size GetParameter, QueryCreate, and allocation-size branch results; no privilege or policy change.
decision_support_retrieval.retrieval_brief: Main may read only the listed R905 lines for the next diagnostic decision. Treat the source/package match as partial and do not attribute the failure to versions, permissions, contexts, or Strata kernels without new evidence.
preserve_caveats: R905-C1: The report identifies mapped runtime/loader and Metrics Discovery/Library SONAME/package versions, and cites the compute-runtime package source version as matching tag 26.31.39395.14. It does not match the installed Metrics Discovery/Library binaries to exact source commits or builds. The manifest dependencies are build pins, not a published runtime compatibility range.

R905-C2: For the captured type PERFORMANCE (enum value 0), the pinned create() switch selects createMetricQueryPool(); its unsupported-type default branch is not reachable. Do not include unsupported descriptor type as a candidate cause for this recorded call.
The API record has no query begin or completed kernel/numerical result. It does not prove a permission failure, context defect, GPU hang, kernel bug, or counter value.

Count 64 denotes internal slots in the pinned Level Zero header and PTI also initializes a 64-slot performance pool; the same count is still passed to Metrics Library and multiplied into report allocation size.
The exact source conclusion is pinned to compute-runtime 26.31.39395.14 and does not establish downstream query behavior.

source_context_corrections: R905-C1: Distinguish installed package/SONAME version identification from exact source identity. Runtime/loader alignment and the named compute-runtime source package tag are useful evidence, but the mapped Metrics Discovery and Metrics Library images have no source commit/build match in this report. The manifest dependency revisions alone do not prove incompatibility or supported compatibility.
R905-C2: Move unsupported descriptor type out of the failure candidates for the observed PERFORMANCE type=0 call; that source default applies only when the descriptor type is unsupported.
scope_depth_review: 1,417 whitespace-delimited words, six primary source families, within the assigned 1,300-1,800-word and six-source limits. The investigation compares multiple source-level failure paths, context handling, version/permission alternatives, and a bounded next diagnostic.
provenance_limit: The receipt provides loaded binary mapping paths and SHA-256 values, plus package/version metadata. The report pins and hashes the compute-runtime implementation and manifest, Level Zero header, and PTI source; it does not pin Metrics Discovery/Library source revisions or prove the loaded binaries byte-for-byte match source. The failure remains unqualified.

next_scope_eligibility.reason: The next evidence must come from a Main-owned, bounded query-pool diagnostic or exact package/source provenance. Fresh research would repeat the same broad error-path question before those results exist.
